850007.m_mTitle: "A Letter Carried by the Sea Breeze"
850007.m_mContent:
"Dear Esteemed Guest of the Bathorys,
Have you heard of Sapphire Isle? Once ruined by the tsunami, it was rebuilt by the hands of the Seven Sages. The tides carried away a heavy past, and from its ruins, a new brilliance has risen.
Let the warm breeze lift your fatigue, and let fine wine lull your senses. At our well-loved auction house, for but a modest price, anything your heart desires may be yours. Countless travelers arrive with hope, and depart with joy.
Now, as high summer draws near and the days grow ever warmer, I extend to you my most sincere invitation. Enclosed is a small token of my regard. I await your arrival and may your time here be nothing short of perfect."

850008.m_mContent:
"Silver-hair:
I had the whole auction house searched. Master Van Helsing wasn't there. And when I got back, you're gone!
What happened? Did you end up neck-deep in debt too? Or did you find a lead and ran off alone? Or... did you never see me as your companion?
Whatever the case, I've enclosed what little money I had left. Hope it helps. You'd better come find me after reading this.
If you don't, I'll haunt you when I become a ghost.
Or a Bloodborn!"

850009.m_mContent: "Noah, Thank you. Without all of you, I might have remained asleep forever, sealed within that little puppet. Tell Miss Ami that I believe she will make a fine Sage. Tell Miss Aiona that I'm grateful for her gentleness and kindness. Tell Miss Selena that I wish we could've watched The Adventures of Ginokio together one more time. While I slept, Sapphire Isle became a place I no longer recognized. But after meeting all of you, I came to love what it's become. If fate allowed, I would've gladly gone on another journey with you. But there's a promise I must keep. Lorelei is still waiting for me. They say a letter lets you glimpse someone's truest thoughts. So if you've read this far... I suppose you know this is my last letter. The money enclosed should be enough to buy a few Tidewisp seeds. Please plant them by the sea for me. That's my last request."

850010.m_mContent:
"Noah,
I made it to Mouret safely.
It feels strange to return—it's been so long since we left.
The Ganelon may lie to the north, but the summers here were always just as vivid in my memory. The meadows, the streams, the markets… everything felt so alive.
I thought I'd never see it like this again, not after everything that happened. But when I stepped onto this land, the flowers and grass beneath my feet reminded me that life can still flourish, even after ruin.
I visited Father. The Wolfsbane is blooming beautifully.
I've enclosed one for you—maybe you can compare it to the ones in the castle's sunroom.
Oh, and… it's my birthday today. I wish you were here to celebrate with me, but reviving the Ganelon is my duty, and I won't stop until it's done.
Still, let's make a promise.
Next year, on this day, we'll stand together in Mouret—restored, alive—and admire the summer we both remember so well.
Goodbye, for now."

850011.m_mContent:
"Noah,
Halfway through my seventh meal, you crossed my mind.
Miss Empousa took my plate while I was lost in thought, insisting I save room for birthday cake.
My appetite demands justice.
The castle is grand, but the food is dreadful. No seafood, no delicacies—only bats. Perhaps you could make me lord of this place so I can restore its culinary dignity.
I wanted to share birthday cake with you.
But when I sought you in your room, you were gone.
I'll entrust this note to Polly. I can only hope by the time it reaches you, the cake won't be half gone.
I'll wait for you in my room. If you're late, you can still polish the plate clean.
—And that has nothing to do with me, truly. You may ask Polly about it.
Ah, there is cream on the note!
How am I still starving after the cake… Oh, looks like you're on the menu?"

850012.m_mContent:
"Noah,
I've finally reached the end.
There's nothing here but sand.
But we will meet again."

850013.m_mContent:
"To whom it may concern:

My name is Agnes, an apprentice Cartographer destined to become the greatest in Minexus!
Soon, I shall embark upon a cross-dimensional study. Your participation would add a splendid chapter to this grand voyage.
Compensation and job responsibilities may be discussed upon meeting.
As a gesture of goodwill, I've enclosed a small gift with this letter. Those interested should come on the night of the full moon to...
(The ink has dried and peeled off, making the handwriting illegible here. You suspect this might be some childish prank from the past.)"

850014.m_mContent:
"To "the future":

 The War between the houses of Ganelon and Bathory has yet to cease. In the face of this historical inertia, our efforts feel exeedingly insignificant.
 Yet this does not mean our sacrifices were in vain. I shall continue to travel the continent, seeking new paths for the Bloodborn. Human blood is not essential—the Pure Blood Essence that I entrusted Mr. Cain to brew makes a perfect substitute. The Bloodborn need not forever hide in darkness; one day, we will surely walk beneath the sunlight.
 I leave this letter somewhere in Bathory Castle, hoping that its reader might set aside hatred and prejudice, and join me in welcoming that beautiful future.
 Even if it is destined to be a long, hard road."

850015.m_mContent:
"Noah,

 There's danger at the festival. Be careful.

 (This letter lay quietly in the Inbox; it seems it didn't arrive in time.)"

850016.m_mContent: "Silver-haired friend, How does it feel to reunite after so long? How could Death cannot bring the dead back to life? Yet great alchemy can achieve this feat. Don't be mistaken—I'm not here to cause trouble. On the path to finding the 'answer' in another world, we will still need each other's strength. Therefore, our partnership will continue. However, I look forward to the day we settle our score."

850019.m_mContent:
"I understand now—this is the truth of the world, the truth we've always sought!
Blood... memory... alchemy... the Church has always tried to keep us in ignorance, but it doesn't matter!
I've finally grasped the key to enlightenment, and I must pen it down!
Even if they come for me, I must...
(The notes show signs of burning and lacerating. All the pages that follow are missing.)"

850020.m_mContent:
"Noah,

You and I, sinners guilty of crimes against time itself, have met amid the realm's turbulence, with time standing as the barrier. There is indeed a certain irony to this.
Our collaboration has been most pleasant, but now we must go forth to fulfill our missions in separate ways.
I hope our paths will cross again one day.
Whether in the past or in the future."

850021.m_mContent:
"Noah,

Are you available? I need to see you as soon as possible.
Recently, the Silver Cross has encountered a troublesome case. Selena and I have been running everywhere, yet we can't find a single clue—the case remains a tangled mess.
Considering our excellent cooperation in the Reese's case, I thought I should send you an invitation.
Also, even though we've been busy all day, Selena insisted I send this letter today.
She says it's a meaningful day and mentioned she hasn't had cake in ages—she's certain you'll bring cake with you.
Though today is my birthday, but I believe the case is our top priority.
However, Selena's been working hard lately, do bring her a cake—I'll cover the expense.
A small one. I don't like eating too much."

850022.m_mContent:
"Little Noah,

Do you still remember what day it is today?
If you have forgotten, my Cloak and every single hand upon it will be most displeased, Little Noah!
Today is my birthday! I have been waiting so very long for this day! Every time I see other Vassals having my Little Noah all to themselves on their birthdays, every single one of my hands clenches into a fist in fury!
Since this is such an important day, you must spend the entire day with me and fulfill my every request!
Otherwise, you will know the power of an elder, little Noah!
Do beware what my thousand hands are capable of..."
